svg.text: Chrome MV3 extension · four runtime contexts · no server, no telemetry, no AI service · v1.7.4
1 · MAIL TAB — CONTENT SCRIPT, PROVIDER ORIGIN
MutationObserver → dirty map (body vs header only)
≤ 4 snapshots per batch · unchanged emails skipped
navigation reset · re-queue on failure (≤ 2 tries)
writes serialised per tab · legacy local entry purged
cleared on navigation, tab close and browser exit
ensureParser(): one DOM_PARSER document, on demand
reused by every tab · PARSER_DROP on tab close
3 · OFFSCREEN DOCUMENT — PARSING HAPPENS AWAY FROM THE MAIL PAGE
4 · SIDE PANEL — REACT 18, EXTENSION PAGE, STRICT CSP
5 · LOCAL STATE AND THE ONLY NETWORK THE PRODUCT MAKES
Mail content, keyed per tab, gone when Chrome exits
Only files the user saves · 20 MB each · 100 MB total
fetch(credentials: include) for images and attachments
THREAD_PARSED → store the thread, then broadcast it
PARSER_BATCH · one serial queue per tab

Blob inline images: panel → READ_PAGE_IMAGE → service worker → READ_BLOB_IMAGE in the mail tab → data: URL back. Dev capture: panel → CAPTURE_THREAD_SOURCE → mail tab. Gmail controls: EXPAND_THREAD / COLLAPSE_THREAD.
